title: Tenant app registration (tenants/<tenant>/apps/<app>-<env>.yaml)
description: Contract of the tenant-workloads-<tenant> ApplicationSets in gitops-control-plane (2026-10-03 Tracks A.2/B.2). Mirrors their template guards, so a registration that passes here renders there.

app.description: Application name prefix; the namespace is <app>-<env>, which the AppProject only allows as orders-* or tenant-*

port.description: host port of the spoke ingress, quoted

valuesRevision.description: orders-processor revision of the values file; prod needs a full commit SHA
